name: Heddle
description: Installs the published Heddle npm package and configures one s6-supervised workflow service for the workspace.

version.description: Heddle package version to install from the npm registry. `latest` installs the registry's current `latest` dist-tag on every build; an exact SemVer version installs that exact version on every build. This is independent of the Feature version.

packageSource.description: Optional Heddle package tarball source. An https URL or absolute path overrides registry resolution.

packageSha256.description: Optional hexadecimal SHA-256 digest required for the resolved Heddle package tarball.

npmRegistry.description: npm registry that serves `@wyrd-company/heddle` when `packageSource` is empty.

configDirectory.description: Absolute operator-owned directory containing required config.yml.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified workspace DNS name exposed through the Caddy Feature.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs Heddle. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, vscode, then root.
